summary: Prepare board-ready dividend and investment recommendations using FCFE, NPV, IRR and disclosure analysis. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Dividend policy and capital allocation training helps finance professionals and company secretaries assess cash for payouts and investment. You’ll forecast dividend capacity using FCFE, compare payout scenarios, appraise investment proposals with NPV, IRR and WACC, and prepare board decision and disclosure materials.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who prepare, review or govern dividend recommendations, capital investment choices and related disclosures.
